items.exampleEn: I am the middle child in my family.
items.exampleZh: 我是家裡排行中間的孩子。

items.exampleEn: Please sit in the front row.
The sun is very bright today.
There are many living things in the sea.

items.sentenceEn: The front door is very heavy.

items.audioEn: My room is small, but it is bright and beautiful.
items.audioZh: 我的房間很小，但很明亮、很漂亮。

items.stemEn: I can't carry this bag. It is too ____.
items.stemZh: 我拿不動這個包包，太重了。

items.stemEn: Open the ____ door. Someone is there.

items.passageEn: My grandmother has a beautiful old house. In the front room, there is a big, heavy table. On the table, there is a gold clock. The windows are big, so the room is bright. Her cat sleeps by the front door all day.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶有一棟漂亮的老房子。前面那個房間裡有一張又大又重的桌子，桌上有一座金色的時鐘。窗戶很大，所以房間很明亮。她的貓整天睡在前門旁邊。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶的時鐘是什麼樣的？

referenceEn: I sit in the middle seat.
I am in the middle seat.
rubricZh: 「中間的」例如 the middle seat；寫 in the middle 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 beautiful 造一個句子，描述美麗的地方或東西。
rubricZh: beautiful 放在名詞前面或 be 動詞後面（例如 a beautiful song、is beautiful）
